card.name: Linking words in allergy trigger lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas (and, to, a, comma) right after allergy wording, where a list of allergens such as dust mites, egg, sesame, or pollen is about to come next.

modes.label: Inside allergen lists
modes.description: A comma or 'and' between allergens, before the next allergen is named.

modes.description: 'to' or 'a' right after allergic, allergies, or 'patients with', before the trigger is named.

card.writes: It promotes allergen nouns like pollen, shell, nut, latex and dust as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in allergy text just before the thing someone is allergic to is named.
